title: achillea tanacetifolia subsp. distans
intro: Achillea tanacetifolia subsp. distans, commonly known as a distant form of Yarrow, is a plant species in the sunflower family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Achillea tanacetifolia subsp. distans include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which can help alleviate digestive issues, reduce fever, and soothe menstrual cramps. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate digestion, calm the nervous system, and promote wound healing, while its bioactive constituents include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids.
